description: First wave of the new-semantics additive-feedback campaign on DSW 5000: RNN seeds1-5 and GRU seed1.

dependency_strategy.tail_handoff: tasks 6-14 migrated to the separate DSW 8095 manifest after all eight source coordinators were stopped

notes: Widths are re-matched to the 586067-parameter GaWF H256 target: rnn_fb_add H272 has 586595 parameters, gru_fb_add H103 has 584665, and lstm_fb_add H79 has 585564.
RNN uses native tanh recurrence; GRU and LSTM use their native gates and official h output. No model has the external LayerNorm/ReLU/dropout wrap.

Each model adds W_fb f_(t-1)+b_fb as an independent input source to the native preactivation. The trainable feedback weight and bias use the native cell uniform bound and the same optimizer LR/weight decay as the rest of the model.
LR/weight decay are inherited without retuning: RNN 0.001/0.00001, GRU 0.005/0.001, LSTM 0.001/0.001. Training is 150 epochs, patience 0, AdamW, checkpoint every 5 epochs, and automatic resume.
The eight queue coordinators were verified alive and waiting behind exact incumbent no-wrap processes. No incumbent process was stopped or modified.

2026-09-23T22:08Z split: tasks0-5 were already active on DSW 5000. All eight coordinators were stopped while these six writers remained alive, preventing tasks6-14 from starting here. The remaining nine units moved to DSW 8095.
